title: Parity sheriff: shadow regression pipeline for INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ/AWQ)
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a shadow-driven regression pipeline (the 'parity sheriff') to validate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) against floating-point baselines across fidelity, stability, and production canary readiness. This ticket covers integration with CI/nightly runners, an automated golden-answer delta auditor, and the shadow canary ladder that feeds telemetry into rollback/alerting rules.

Background: We have multiple upstream artifacts: quantization profile registry, calibration snapshots, and the runtime kernels that implement GPTQ/AWQ weight-only transforms. Historically, regressions surfaced late due to flaky manual checks and insufficient longitudinal drift signals. The parity sheriff is intended to catch regressions earlier by running a fast but comprehensive shadow regression: shadow inference runs side-by-side with FP16 baseline on sample traffic plus deterministic evaluation prompt sets.

Scope and acceptance criteria:
- Integrate shadow runner into canary infra so every canary evaluates: golden-set inference, sampled production shadow, and nightly stability sweep.
- Acceptance thresholds: median answer-delta (BLEU/ROUGE or normalized log-prob delta depending on model family) <= 1.5% relative to FP16 on the golden set; embedding cosine similarity >= 0.985; token-level perplexity shift <= 3%.
- Latency/throughput: quantized runtime CPU/GPU kernel should not increase p99 token latency by >5% for target seqlen distributions.
- Telemetry: produce per-request metrics: answer-delta, embedding-sim, token-perplexity-diff, kernel-fallbacks, and per-layer saturation counts. Alerts fire when regression persists for 3 consecutive runs or when customer-impacting failures observed.
- Rollout policy: shadow-only -> small-routed-canary (1%) with automated rollback when thresholds violated -> staged increase to 10/50/100.

Planned deliverables:
1) Shadow runner service (lightweight wrapper) that runs configured model variant pairs (FP16 vs INT8 GPTQ/AWQ) and emits standard telemetry.
2) Golden answer harness: curated prompt corpora per model bucket (chat, completion, retrieval) + auto-scorers and per-prompt metadata.
3) Canary ladder orchestration: new canary step types and automated decision rules in the rollout controller.
4) Nightly stability sweep: longer-run randomized prompt sequences with drift scoring and report generation.
5) CI integration: unit/functional tests in PRs, a regression job in the quant-profile pipeline, and a human-readable runbook for incident responders.

Engineering trade-offs considered:
- Full fidelity shadow (every token) vs sampled light-weight checks: we choose sampled production shadow for latency-sensitive paths plus full golden-set nightly sweeps to keep cost manageable.
- Per-layer recalibration in GPTQ vs global-scale AWQ stability: pipeline keeps both strategies available and tags profiles with 'recalibration_hint' so the sheriff knows which evaluation buckets need extra scrutiny.
- Compute cost: prefer batched shadow runs with KV-cache reuse to reduce token-cost while keeping representative latency.

Testing matrix and signals:
- Unit tests: serialization/deserialization of quant-profiles, profile registry lookups, and fallback logic.
- Integration tests: end-to-end golden-set runs in staging with seeded RNG to compare numeric answers deterministically.
- Regression gates: nightly job that fails on sustained drifts; PR checks for any change to profile registry require opt-in 'profile-impact' tag and a green regression baseline run.

Telemetry and dashboards:
- New dashboard: QuantParity/Model/<model-name>/profile-compare with histograms of answer-delta, embedding-sim, KL divergence, and per-layer overflow/saturation.
- Alerts: critical if median embedding-sim < 0.97 or if >5% of requests hit kernel fallback paths.

Rollout and incident playbook summary:
- Shadow: run for 48h across sampled requests; if any golden-set threshold breached, stop and create regression ticket with full dump, telemetry traces, and seed used.
- Canary: small routed traffic with automatic rollback on 3 consecutive failing evaluation runs or a single critical kernel exception.
- Postmortem: include regression diff, seed, quant-profile used, kernel/hardware pairing, and snapshot of calibration parameters.

Notes on reproducibility:
- We persist calibration snapshots and random seeds used for GPTQ re-orderings to allow deterministic replays.
- All shadow runs attach kernel-version and HW SKU metadata to telemetry to detect heterofleet anomalies.

Related artifacts and owners: Marco Ruiz (integration lead), Priya Singh (QA/evangelist), Diego Morales (runtime/kernel), Lena Chen (PM for regression policy).
comments: 2025-11-15 Asha Patel: Kickoff - defined scope and initial acceptance criteria. Added Marco as assignee. Need to finalize golden prompt lists and per-model scoring metric mapping.

2025-11-18 Marco Ruiz: Implemented initial shadow runner prototype. It supports paired runs and emits provisional telemetry keys. PR opened: platform#4312. Observed 0.8% median answer-delta for small-llm on the toy set.
2025-11-19 Priya Singh: QA: started creating golden prompt corpora for chat, completion, and retrieval families. Found that retrieval prompts need longer context to surface differences.

2025-11-21 Diego Morales: Runtime note - AWQ kernels show per-layer saturation on a specific FFN pattern on A100s. Adding per-layer saturation counters to telemetry. Need kernel patch; blocking canary until mitigation.
2025-11-22 Lena Chen: PM review - updated rollout policy to include shadow 48h soak and 'three-run' gating. Also added customer-impact tagging for model buckets.
2025-11-24 Marco Ruiz: Merged initial runner. Nightly stability sweep job added to quant-profile CI. Created playbook stub for rollback automation.

2025-11-26 QA Bot: Nightly run failed the embedding-sim threshold on 2 of 10 models (medium family). Created ENG-814272 to investigate calibration snapshot drift. Marking this ticket still in progress.

2025-11-28 Priya Singh: Added additional golden-set prompts for the failed models; re-ran on staging with updated calibration hints. Embedding-sim improved from 0.962 to 0.988 in synthetic runs. Follow-up: schedule longer-run canary with the patched kernels.
2025-11-28 Diego Morales: Kernel patch branch opened GH#4369 to address FFN saturation. Plan: run patch in shadow canary on dedicated pool before broad rollout.
